SYNOPSIS
     join [-a file_number | -v file_number] [-e string] [-o list] [-t char]
	  [-1 field] [-2 field] file1 file2

     -a file_number
     -e string
     -o list
     -t char
     -v file_number
     -1 field
     -2 field
     -b option, on the fields on which they are to be joined, otherwise join
